chars.YOUSSEF: a Moroccan man around 30 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.SALMA: a Moroccan woman around 27 with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a burgundy satin long-sleeve pyjama top and gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modern Casablanca apartment bedroom: YOUSSEF and SALMA lie in the same bed turned away from each other, back to back, both awake with tense, cold, unhappy faces, dim bedside lamp light, a wide gap between them

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Morning kitchen in a Casablanca apartment: YOUSSEF and SALMA sit at a small breakfast table with tea glasses, not looking at each other, SALMA scrolling her phone, YOUSSEF staring at her with a bored, frustrated expression

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Evening Moroccan living room with a traditional salon sofa: YOUSSEF sits alone on the salon sofa in the dark, lit by the TV glow, looking sadly toward a closed bedroom door down the hallway where light shows under the door

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF stands on a small Casablanca apartment balcony at night, hands on his head, worried and thinking hard, city lights and rooftops with satellite dishes behind him

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF sits on the edge of the bed holding his wedding ring between his fingers, looking at it with a regretful, conflicted expression, soft morning light from a window

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF at his job in a busy Casablanca office, rubbing his tired eyes at his desk, exhausted, then grabbing his car keys to leave early, coworkers in the background

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF quietly opening the front door of his Casablanca apartment with his key, stepping into the dim hallway, surprised, leaning his head to listen, a woman's voice coming from a half-open bedroom door at the end of the hallway

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Seen through a half-open bedroom door: SALMA sits on the bed with her back half turned, whispering on her phone pressed to her ear, smiling secretly and emotional, unaware she is being watched

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the hallway, YOUSSEF stands frozen behind the half-open bedroom door, eyes wide in shock, hand over his mouth, while SALMA is visible inside the bedroom on the phone, not seeing him
